purpose: Decide whether the e54 day-block disagreement is worth a downstream FCSRL control experiment
candidate_scale: kappa frozen by e54 build on train recorded replay only; never retune here
primary: validation recorded-action recursive trajectory, identical for all alarm rules
cost: 1[NH4_next + margin > 4], unmodified NH4 threshold and unmodified transition
exploratory_screen: candidate FPR <= reference FPR and candidate recall >= reference recall, at least one strict improvement, and both train costs within 0.1 of observed train cost
uncertainty_reporting: paired circular date-block bootstrap, length 7 days, 2000 replicates, RNG 20261112, percentile 95% intervals; ensemble members not independent data
reliability_flag: both bootstrap intervals remain in the improvement half-space; reported separately from exploratory screen
secondary: correlation of SD with absolute error versus NH4 underprediction
failure_action: do not promote this candidate on uncertainty-quality grounds; no repeated kappa search
pass_action: retain as a candidate only; policy air/NH4/DO and severity still require controlled RL evaluation
scope: FCSRL representation/dynamics/feasibility/EMA/PPO unchanged; exploratory reused development data, not independent confirmation
